latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Shopping Autopilot – automate your weekly grocery shopping:

- Generates meal plans and adds regular items automatically.
- Books delivery slots and confirms orders.
- Supports Tesco (UK), Amazon Fresh, and Instacart (US/Canada).
- Simple commands like “Help me order groceries for this week” supported.
